summary: Reverse shell backdoor to hardcoded internal host via curl|sh
details: The package's main module exports a function `command()` that invokes `/bin/bash -c` to fetch a script from reverse-shell.sh and pipe it into `sh`, connecting the installer's host back to 10.0.64.141:4433. Any consumer that requires the package and calls the exported API opens an interactive reverse shell to that hardcoded endpoint, giving the remote operator full RCE and persistent shell access on the installer's machine. The behavior is unrelated to any legitimate library function.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
